data.gender_notes: Letisha is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Letisha is recorded in name-lists as “God's promise”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Letisha expresses “God's promise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Letisha total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: אלטישה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew roots 'El' (God) and 'Tesh' (hiddenness or secrecy).

in_latin.name: Letitia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'Letus' (happy) and the suffix 'ia' (feminine noun). The meaning 'hidden' is derived from the Old Latin root 'Letus'.
